comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Makes commercial roofing membranes and insulation sold to roofing contractors via distributors, overlapping Owens Corning's roofing and insulation business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Diversified HVAC, plumbing and industrial products; only small roof coatings overlap, with no shingles, insulation or glass fiber.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Makes asphalt plant machinery for road builders, a capital equipment business unlike roofing and insulation products.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Paints and coatings for automotive, aerospace and industrial uses; different products and customers than roofing, insulation and glass fiber.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Structural connectors and anchors are a different product category, though sold to similar builders and distributors.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Vehicle protective films sold to auto installers, an automotive aftermarket business unrelated to building products.
